analysis.scoreReason: RSI 과매수 진입 + MACD 개선세 지속

· 현 구간 진단 (상승추세) — RSI 과매수 진입에도 MACD 개선세 지속으로 매수 유지
analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price ($334.15) vs SMA5 ($305.78)/SMA20 ($287.25)/SMA50 ($294.52) — trading above short/mid-term trends.
· Position relative to SMA100 ($352.00)/SMA200 ($466.91) — below long-term trends, indicating short-term strength.
· 52-week position (14.5%) — significantly higher from historical lows.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (66.5 → 69.0) — entering overbought territory, maintaining upward momentum.
· MACD histogram trajectory (5.8846 → 6.2932) — continuously improving, signaling bullish expansion.
· Bollinger Band position (Upper band $318.97) — breaking above the upper band, indicating bullish expansion.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support ($300.50) — based on Pivot S1 ($284.30) and SMA50 ($294.52).
· Swing resistance ($363.18) — further upside expected upon breaking R1 ($359.08).
· 5-day/20-day High/Low pattern (Higher Low) — uptrend recovery maintained.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (0.58x) — subdued volume, slightly lowering conviction in the rally.
· Current phase diagnosis (Uptrend) — maintaining buy despite RSI overbought due to continued MACD improvement.
